Closed transfer walks enumerate exactly all admissible ordered cyclic gap lists; n/k corrects labelled roots without orbit assumptions. Independent exact-rational full deletion reconstruction checked 6688 small instances, and independent transfer/subset enumeration checked 77 instances and both explicit B=3/B=4 phase formulas. These finite tests do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: One pinned source may fail without graph deletion in practical discounted consensus networks; exact resource redundancy under a uniform worst-vertex threshold is naturally motivated. The result supplies an exact feasibility cliff, all-fidelity sharp minimum, all-optimum labelled classification and arbitrary-parameter transfer count. Even cutoff B=4 yields reliability conditions and phase counts not obtainable by substituting a classical integer domination radius, so this is not only the source-paper path-transfer lemma or a small numerical improvement. The result is a natural complete classification within cycles, while arbitrary graphs and multiple failures remain open.
